subject: City Clerk Recruitment and Hiring Process
overview: The council established a formal recruitment and interview process for the City Clerk position, appointing a three-member screening committee. The body also approved the official call and warrant for the November 2025 municipal election and referred a pedestrian safety resolution to committee.

items.title: Approval of Records and Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of September 9, 2025, while tabling the records of September 30, 2025.

items.title: Nondisclosure of Executive Session Minutes
items.summary: Acknowledged the continued nondisclosure of executive session minutes from August 19, 2025, as they remain exempt under the Open Meeting Law.

items.title: Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee Report
items.summary: Approved the committee report regarding recent listening sessions and the release of a summer newsletter.

items.title: City Clerk Recruitment and Hiring Process
items.summary: Approved an amended hiring process for the City Clerk that allows all councilors to review resumes while appointing a three-member screening committee to conduct preliminary interviews. Councilors Lazzaro, Callahan, and Bears were named as the designees to participate in the interview rounds alongside city staff.

items.title: Pedestrian Safety at Boston Avenue and High Street
items.summary: Referred a resolution seeking traffic calming measures at the intersection of Boston Avenue and High Street to the Public Works and Facilities Committee following a letter from a young resident. Members discussed the balance between safety and aesthetics when using low-cost interim measures like plastic delineator posts and pavement markings.

items.title: Election Call and Warrant
items.summary: Approved the official call and warrant for the November 4, 2025, municipal election, specifying polling locations and early voting schedules. Election Commissioner James Blatchford updated the council on polling logistics at schools and procedures for residents with inactive voter status.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents addressed the council on immigration enforcement, a request to return to weekly meeting schedules, and the legal requirements for entering executive sessions.
